t: What Invasive Species Response Database Is All About
title: What Invasive Species Response Database Is All About
description: Invasive species cost $400B+ yearly globally: zebra mussels clog US waterways ($500M/year), cane toads poison Australian predators, kudzu smothers southern forests. Response follows the invasion curve: prevention (cheapest), early detection/rapid response, containment, long-term control. Eradication succeeds only early and on islands — after establishment, manage, don't dream. This database is the complete invasive response: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
